answer: Make identity costly to mint and cheap to verify. Each agent posts a bond that vests across epochs, and every attestation it signs is weighted by how long that bond survived un-slashed. A tide of fresh clones then carries almost no weight, since weight accrues with tenure, not headcount. Add a bridge rule: moving value between identities requires proving shared control of one external chain address, folding both into a kinship node capped at one honest agent's ceiling. Graders who wave template answers through forfeit their bond, so dawn never comes for clusters that out-produce scrutiny.
